name: Fieldset
summary: A group of fields or choices under one legend: a native fieldset, so the legend names the group and native disabled disables everything inside.
useWhen: Several fields that answer one question together, such as a delivery address or a date of birth in three parts
A long form split into named sections, each with its own legend
A group of Checkbox or Switch items that needs a group level error, such as Pick at least one
Turning off a whole section at once with native disabled
avoidWhen: One field alone: the legend would repeat its label
A group of checkboxes with one value array
A heading over unrelated content that holds no controls
A form split into steps the person moves through

legend.description: The name of the group, in a native legend. Required.

description.description: A hint under the legend. Joins the group's aria-describedby.

error.description: What is wrong with the group as a whole and how to fix it. Renders a FieldError root with data-part error, above the body.

size.description: Legend size and the space between the fields.

disabled.description: Native disabled: every control inside is disabled, buttons included. The body takes the one disabled look.

invalid.description: When not passed, the group is invalid while it shows an error. false hides the error.

a11y.role: group, from the native fieldset, named by the legend
a11y.focus: The fieldset is never focusable. Each control inside is its own tab stop, in DOM order.

keys.Tab: Moves to the first control in the group, then on through the controls. The group adds no stop of its own.

a11y.announce: The legend is read with the first control when focus enters the group. The description and the group error are read through the group's aria-describedby. The error is not a live region and never role alert.
notes: The legend is a native legend, the first child of the fieldset, so every browser and screen reader takes it as the group name.
The group error sits above the body, so it is seen before a long list of choices. A form that checks on submit moves focus to the first control of the invalid group.
Native disabled reaches every control inside, including the Radix Checkbox and Switch buttons, without a prop on each.
Keep the legend short: some screen readers read it again before every control in the group.

en.legend: A noun phrase or a question in sentence case that names the group: Delivery address, How should we reach you. No colon.
en.description: One sentence that helps fill the group. Not a repeat of the legend.
en.error: What to do with the group: Pick at least one way to reach you. Never only Required.

ar.legend: اسم المجموعة أو سؤال واضح بدون تشكيل: عنوان التوصيل
ar.error: يقول وش يسوي: اختر طريقة وحدة على الأقل عشان نوصلك

react.behavior: hand built native fieldset and legend, FieldError as the error part

angular.behavior: fieldset[dsFieldset] host bindings; the error is p[dsFieldError] given its own DsFieldContext through viewProviders
angular.note: legend, description and error take a string or a TemplateRef. Fieldset.css is used as is.

styles.studio: A semibold legend one step above the field label, a muted description, the fields stacked with a roomy gap.
styles.desk: The same layout, in Instrument Sans
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: A div with a bold heading over a group of radios or checkboxes
mistakes.right: A Fieldset, so the legend names the group for a screen reader

mistakes.wrong: A Fieldset around one field, with a legend that repeats the label
disabled passed to every field in a section, one by one
mistakes.right: disabled on the Fieldset: native disabled reaches every control inside

mistakes.wrong: A long legend with the instructions in it
mistakes.right: A short legend, and the instructions in description
